stories.headline: Northern Cyprus ferry disaster: at least seven dead as vessel capsizes – latest updates

opening: An estimated 237 people have been rescued but 23 are missing after accident off the coast of northern Cyprus Fatalities after ferry carrying nearly 270 capsizes off northern Cyprus.
The Filo Denizcilik company, which operates the capsized passenger boat, has put out a statement saying it is “deeply saddened” by the “tragic accident”.
body: It said the priority is the safety of the passengers and crew on board.

The statement continued: From the moment the incident occurred, a crisis management team was established within our company, and all our resources were mobilized to the field in full coordination with all authorized search and rescue teams.
Search and rescue and evacuation efforts are being.

stories.title: Russia advancing along entire frontline in special op’s zone — Kremlin spokesman
stories.summary: The dynamic is absolutely positive for Russia, Dmitry Peskov said
article_sentences: Russian forces are advancing along the entire frontline in the zone of the special military operation, Russian presidential press secretary Dmitry Peskov said.
Our advance is obvious and the dynamic is absolutely positive for us," he told Vesti host Pavel Zarubin.
